meta.note: Landmarks with a 'model' are drawn as stylised 3D models at 'position'; the rest is context for station pages. Only public places are named; shops and businesses in the scene use invented names. positionQuality 'approximate' means the exact footprint or side of the road is not published.

landmarks.name: Poonamallee Depot
landmarks.description: Phase II rolling-stock depot (DPT-01). Trial runs of the Alstom trains began from here in March 2025.
landmarks.source: The Metro Rail Guy — 'Chennai Metro Phase 2's Trial Runs Begin from Poonamallee Depot' (Mar 2025)
landmarks.positionSource: Wikipedia — Poonamallee Bypass metro station (depot beside the station, 24 tracks). Footprint and side not published.

landmarks.name: Poonamallee Bus Stand
landmarks.description: Poonamallee station is listed as Poonamallee Bus Stand in CMRL's fare announcement. The MTC terminus serves more than 30 routes, including Vellore, Kanchipuram and Tirupati.
landmarks.source: DT Next — fares article (Sep 2026); Goibibo — Poonamallee Bus Stand
landmarks.positionSource: TellMyRoute — MTC GTFS stop 'Poonamallee Bus Terminus' (13.05086, 80.09371). A stop point, not the terminus outline.

landmarks.name: Sri Varadaraja Perumal Temple
landmarks.description: Vaishnavite temple in Poonamallee, associated with the saint Thirukachi Nambi, who was born here.

landmarks.name: Government Hospital, Poonamallee
landmarks.description: Mullaithottam station is also known as Poonamallee Government Hospital. The hospital is at 600 Trunk Road, Mullai Thottam.
landmarks.source: Wikipedia — Mullaithottam metro station; Practo — Government Hospital, Poonamallee
landmarks.positionSource: Street address only (600 Trunk Road, Mullai Thottam); placed beside the station that is named after it. Side of the road assumed.

landmarks.name: Mount–Poonamallee Road
landmarks.description: Kattupakkam lies on Mount–Poonamallee Road, about 20 km from Fort St George.

landmarks.name: Iyyappanthangal Bus Depot
landmarks.description: Six-acre MTC bus terminus on Mount–Poonamallee Road, opened in 1994.
landmarks.positionSource: TellMyRoute — stop 'Iyyappanthangal Bus Depot, Mount Poonamallee Road, VGN Nagar'. Exact site and side of the road not published.

landmarks.name: Porur Lake
landmarks.description: About 200 acres (46 million cubic feet), on the south-western fringe of Porur and a drinking-water source for the city. Drawn smaller than the real lake and set back so its shore clears the road.

landmarks.name: Bharat Ratna Puratchi Thalaivar M.G.R. Flyover
landmarks.nameTa: பாரத ரத்னா புரட்சித் தலைவர் எம்.ஜி.ஆர். மேம்பாலம்
landmarks.description: 505 m, four-lane flyover on Mount–Poonamallee Road over Porur Junction, opened 25 June 2017 at a cost of ₹54 crore. West of the junction it runs beneath the metro, which crosses above it on steel portal beams; at the junction the metro turns north-east up Arcot Road while the flyover carries on east-south-east towards Guindy. Shown in 3D; its height is drawn lower than real to fit under the modelled viaduct.
landmarks.source: india.com / PTI (June 2017); Wikipedia — Flyovers in Chennai; DT Next

landmarks.name: Arcot Road double-decker
landmarks.description: 3.75 km two-tier viaduct between Alapakkam and Alwarthirunagar: Line 4 on the lower deck, Line 5 on the upper deck, with shared concourses at four stations.

landmarks.name: Vadapalani Bus Depot
landmarks.description: MTC depot of about 6.65 acres on Arcot Road with over 158 buses, among the city's busiest; planned for redevelopment as an integrated bus terminal.
landmarks.source: DT Next — 'Vadapalani depot to get a facelift for Rs 481 crore'
landmarks.positionSource: Mappls — 'Vadapalani MTC Bus Stop, Arcot Road' (13.050403, 80.206759). Depot outline and side of the road not published.

landmarks.name: Nexus Vijaya Mall
landmarks.description: Shopping mall on Arcot Road just west of Vadapalani station, formerly Forum Vijaya Mall. Modelled on a photo of its front: a sweeping silver canopy over glass blocks, with a landscaped forecourt. Hoardings show invented ads.
landmarks.source: Satellite view and reference photo supplied by the project owner; public listing on Arcot Road, Vadapalani.
landmarks.positionSource: Traced from satellite imagery supplied by the project owner: north side of Arcot Road, about 180 m before Vadapalani station.

landmarks.name: Kamala Cinemas
landmarks.description: Single-screen cinema on Arcot Road beside Vadapalani station, with a large open car park in front. Modelled on a photo of its white front; film posters are invented.
landmarks.source: Satellite view and reference photo supplied by the project owner; public listing on Arcot Road, Vadapalani.
landmarks.positionSource: Traced from satellite imagery supplied by the project owner: south side of Arcot Road just west of Vadapalani station, behind its car park.

landmarks.name: Vadapalani Murugan Temple
landmarks.description: Temple to Murugan, with a 40.8 m eastern gopuram carved with the 108 Bharatanatyam poses.

landmarks.name: Green Line interchange
landmarks.description: Vadapalani is also on the Phase I Green Line (open since 29 June 2015). The combined station is elevated with 4 tracks on 3 platform levels.
